name: Morrigan the Pale
description: A gaunt elven archivist who guards the forbidden tomes in Valkarith's black library. Her eyes hold centuries of secrets.

name: Drak Stonefist
description: A retired Iron Legion captain who now keeps order at the Ironhold tavern. His loyalty to the Legion never faded.

name: Sylvara Ash
description: A half-elven herbalist operating out of Thornwood who supplies both healers and poisoners without judgment.
benefits_intimate: Her personal remedy for a lethal affliction

name: Vex
description: A goblin information broker in Shadowfen who knows every secret worth knowing — for the right price.
benefits_intimate: Direct access to the shadow network

name: Caldris the Hollow
description: A plague doctor who wanders the Ashen Wastes, tending to survivors of the ancient catastrophe.
benefits_intimate: The truth about what caused the Ashening
